mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% annualized, coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) upswing, signals stronger household balance sheets and durable goods demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 3% YoY and HOUST > 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or IC rank drops below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 0.5% MoM signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC rank falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in federal funds rates above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or IC rank drops below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 2% YoY, coincident with falling housing starts (HOUST), signals weakening household demand and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 2% YoY and HOUST < 0.3% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC rank falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k monthly signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC rank drops below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM, coincident with rising real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1), signals improving manufacturing activity and higher earnings potential, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 1% MoM and GDPC1 > 2% YoY for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or IC rank falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
